l3_edits.old: Initially you own zero shares, and you cannot sell shares when you don't own any. At the end of the N days you would like to again own zero shares, but want to have as much money as possible.
l3_edits.new: Initially your inventory is zero. A sale decreases your inventory by one and credits the day's price; a purchase increases your inventory by one and debits that price. Your inventory must never be positive: you may sell borrowed shares and later buy them back. At the end of the N days your inventory must again be zero, and you want to have as much money as possible.

sample_explanation_policy: Original sample inputs retained in full. Outputs regenerated using isolated L3 reference. Old output-dependent explanations replaced; post-sample definitions and constraints retained.
